scope: Candidate 1.2.0 reports XPST0081 during compilation of effective XSLT 4.0 template patterns when a lexical QName or prefixed wildcard uses an unavailable prefix. This includes native prefixes excluded by fixed-namespaces and undeclared prefixes without fixed bindings. A shared XPath-lexer check covers node names, attributes, axes, paths, union/set operands, function/variable references and nested type patterns; string literals, nested comments and EQName URIs remain protected. Earlier-profile loading retains its existing behavior. Thirty-three regressions cover omitted bindings, Unicode and dotted prefixes, protected text, native bindings across 2.0/3.0/4.0 and a direct lexical check distinguishing spaced map-entry delimiters from prefix wildcards; the initial twenty-four-test baseline was 4/20/0. Native next-match remains 46/8/6 and type-alias remains 22/10/0; upstream assertions and fixtures are unchanged. This bounded check does not perform full eager pattern compilation. String-template interpolation checks, non-template authoring/static contexts, broader pattern grammar, schema-defined atomic priorities, lower-version native fixture processor selection, record/result cases and annotated function types remain follow-ups. N04/N05 and REQ-126 remain In Progress. Published version remains 1.1.3; candidate 1.2.0 remains unpublished.
